name: Word of the Coven (Coven, Teamwork)
body:
Speaking as one, you can baffle even magical lie detection.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, coven member

Benefit(s): When multiple members of a coven with this feat are speaking together, anyone attempting to use Sense Motive to understand them must roll once for each participating member and take the lowest result.

Further, spells like detect lies and zone of truth consider statements made together as the truth as long as it would be the truth for at least one participating member. For example, a group of covenmembers could “truthfully” provide an alibi for one if another was at that location.
